title: Bosch — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Bosch.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Invented for Life." Premium tier. Bosch has been engineering home appliances in Germany since 1886. Their dishwashers consistently rank #1 in the industry — the 300, 500, and 800 Series cover every price point. They pioneered the third rack, CrystalDry technology, and remain the quietest dishwashers you can buy. BSH (Bosch Siemens Hausgerate) is the parent company also behind Thermador and Gaggenau.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-conscious buyers who want European styling, quiet operation, and proven reliability. Kitchen remodels where the dishwasher is the anchor purchase.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Bosch:

• Quietest dishwashers in the industry — 44 dBA (500 Series) means you can have a conversation next to it

• CrystalDry on 800 Series uses volcanic element to achieve 60% better drying than heated dry

• Third rack is standard even on 300 Series — competitors charge extra

• FlexInduction cooktops let you merge two zones into one large cooking area

• Home Connect WiFi across the line — one app controls everything
